verdict.rationale: The evidence never names a sandbox or test environment. Moss can index and query locally on-device or in the browser, with unlimited local queries, and indexes can be created and deleted at will. That gives an implied workaround for experimenting without touching cloud production indexes, but no documented isolation guarantee. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/test mode or separate dev/prod project environments, test keys distinct from production keys, documentation of data isolation between environments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
